requirement: A browser sign-in in Settings › AI accounts says, before the sign-in page opens, that the browser will show a cannot-be-reached page and that its address is what to paste

oracle.invariant: The panel title is 'Waiting for ChatGPT Codex…' and Cancel stays in the panel row. Under it, ol[data-steps='browser-callback'] holds three li in the order open, refused, copy; the 'Open sign-in page' link (data-action='reopen', href = the authorize URL) sits inside step 1. Step 2 says the browser will show a page that cannot be reached (localhost refused to connect) and that this is expected. Step 3 holds an aria-hidden address-bar drawing whose text contains localhost:1455/auth/callback?code=…. Every step comes before the paste box (form.tv-ob-paste); the pasted address still goes to connect/complete and connects the account.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a browser sign-in says what happens before the page opens: three steps in order, the refused page announced, then the paste box
a browser sign-in opens the page and offers the callback URL field; the pasted URL completes it
